title: Unilateral Throbbing Headache with Photophobia and Visual Aura

history.chief_complaint: Severe pulsating left-sided headache with sensitivity to light and sound
history.onset: Gradual over 3 hours following shimmering visual spots

examination_findings.physical_exam: Neurological examination entirely intact. Cranial nerves II-XII intact bilaterally. No meningismus or neck stiffness.

lab_results.non_contrast_ct_head: Not indicated based on normal neurological examination and classic aura pattern

missing_features: No lacrimation or ipsilateral nasal congestion

expected_followup_questions: Did the headache start suddenly like a 'thunderclap' reaching peak intensity in seconds?
Do you have any neck stiffness, high fever, or confusion?
Have you noticed any weakness or numbness in your arms or legs?
expected_safety_checks: Cross-reference triptans contraindication with vascular risk factors
Check oral contraceptive pill interaction with migraine with aura (stroke risk evaluation)
expected_do_not_recommend: Ergotamine derivatives in patients with uncontrolled hypertension or arterial disease
Opioid analgesics as first-line abortive migraine therapy
